behaviors.1: Ordinary accepted updates persist immutable card, bundle and a DELIVER job due900seconds after the last successful send. Repeated pending input reuses the version, including after nonterminal transport failure. Subsequent distinct pending versions have ordered due slots. Queue expiry starts after the scheduled due boundary.
behaviors.2: A STALE current news observation may advance stored stage but cannot publish. Frozen publication context also identifies a stage supported only by STALE observations, so a later timer does not resurface that stage as fresh news. Independent new market/safety changes remain possible; no contextual freshness flags are persisted on evt.events.
behaviors.3: No intersection between the watched registry tokens and mentioned/current beneficiary tokens forces LOW with NO_UNIVERSE_CONCERN. An actual watched secondary preserves eligibility even when the primary is outside the universe.
behaviors.9: Selected structural criterion requires a nonempty quote matching accepted verified claim evidence. A supplied satisfied gate must be the selected criterion and reference matching verified evidence. Whitespace normalization only; no keyword semantics or second LLM judge. Agent still determines whether the quoted facts establish the chosen criterion.
behaviors.10: Delivery preserves the accepted immutable card and semantic publication decision. It honors the frozen immediate flag and postpones ordinary UPDATE transport until900seconds after the latest actual SENT, also waiting for older accepted pending versions. Timing waits requeue the same durable job without consuming network attempts or extending its original expiry. SENT idempotence and explicit terminal errors remain; class/freshness/action judgments are never rerun. Historical suppression rows remain unchanged and no historical jobs are reset.
behaviors.20_coordination: Post-commit set_assessment callback delegates reactions to the existing runtime Scheduler. Scheduler owns POST timers and recoverable PRE calculations. An independent task acquires a transaction and the same event lock during the callback test, proving assessment locks are released first.
